title: Tell me how my subscribers are doing, by area
summary: Once a week, count your active subscribers and add up what they pay each month, for each area, and send you the list.
description: On the day and time you choose, reads your active subscribers from your subscribers table, groups them by area, and sends you one message: for each area, how many subscribers and what they pay each month, then the total. Subscribers with no area are counted together. It looks at up to 1,000 subscribers; with more, it says so.

params.name: day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week the summary comes.

params.name: subscribers_table
params.title: Subscribers table
params.description: Your subscribers: name, phone, plan, price each month, when it renews and whether they are active. Taskiem makes it for you if it does not exist.

definition.name: Tell me how my subscribers are doing, by area
definition.description: Sends the owner each area's subscriber count and monthly income.

steps.name: Group them by area and add each group up

output.areas: =groupBy(has(steps.read_subscribers.output.rows) ? steps.read_subscribers.output.rows : [], 'area').map(g, {'area': g.key == null ? 'No area' : string(g.key), 'count': g.count, 'monthly_naira': sum(g.items.map(r, has(r.monthly_naira) && r.monthly_naira != null ? r.monthly_naira : 0))})

input.title: Your subscribers, by area
input.message: =size(steps.by_area.output.rows) == 0 ? 'You have no active subscribers yet.' : steps.by_area.output.areas.map(a, a.area + ': ' + string(a.count) + ' (N' + string(a.monthly_naira) + ' a month)').join('; ') + '. In all: ' + string(size(steps.by_area.output.rows)) + ' subscribers, N' + string(sum(steps.by_area.output.areas.map(a, a.monthly_naira))) + ' a month.' + (has(steps.read_subscribers.output.next_cursor) && steps.read_subscribers.output.next_cursor != null && string(steps.read_subscribers.output.next_cursor) != '' ? ' Only the first 1,000 subscribers are counted.' : '')
